{"path": "btn.py", "content": "from gpiozero import Button
from signal import pause
# Button wired BCM2 -> GND, no external pull-up resistor.
# Enable the internal pull-up so the pin reads high when not pressed (not floating).
btn = Button(2, pull_up=True)
pause()

text: Fixed: the button had no pull-up, so the pin floated and read randomly. Enable the internal pull-up with Button(2, pull_up=True) so the pin reads high when not pressed.
